title: Use trajectory-driven Pose Search during active shell locomotion

observed_failure.code_cause: QueryPoseSearch enters the balance-idle branch because IsBalanceActiveState includes LocomotionActiveShell

hypothesis: Active shell locomotion must retain balance physics while bypassing the standing-only idle Pose Search branch. When LocomotionActiveShell uses the existing bridge trajectory query, the selected reference animation and policy outputs will respond to the scripted movement trajectory, while BalanceActive_Standing remains locked to idle.
single_behavior_change: Introduce an explicit standing-idle Pose Search predicate used only by QueryPoseSearch, excluding LocomotionActiveShell and LocomotionActiveShellDenied; include locomotion in inference attempt/success evidence counters.
explicit_exclusions: Do not change motion database assets, trajectory thresholds, shell speed, script timing, policy scales, gains, root authority, or causal criterion.
Do not force a walk animation by name.
Do not accept fallback idle as locomotion success.
tdd_contract: BalanceActive_Standing uses the balance-idle Pose Search path.
LocomotionActiveShell does not use the balance-idle Pose Search path.
LocomotionActiveShellDenied does not use the balance-idle Pose Search path.
A Normal scripted product run selects at least one non-idle animation during Acceleration/Cruise/MovingTurn/Deceleration.
DropTrajectoryConditioning does not publish bridge trajectory conditioning and must not satisfy the locomotion-reference criterion.
next_if_supported: Rerun Normal-1 and ZeroActions-1, recalculate the locked stability-cost ratio, then proceed to the complete E60 bundle if ratio <= 0.9.
